name: City of Asheville
source_citation: City of Asheville Annual Council Priorities (Hurricane Helene recovery)
mission: Provides city services for Asheville and leads recovery after Hurricane Helene.
funder_affinities: Department of Housing and Urban Development

goals.title: Economy
goals.citation: City of Asheville Annual Council Priorities (Hurricane Helene recovery): Economy
goals.description: Ensure businesses impacted by the disaster can recover and rebuild; strengthen support for underrepresented businesses; build a diversified, resilient economic base.
objectives: Ensure businesses impacted by the disaster have access to resources needed to recover and rebuild
Strengthen outreach and support for underrepresented businesses
Expand the contractor pool for recovery and resilience projects
Strengthen resilience through a diversified and sustainable economic base

goals.title: Housing
goals.citation: City of Asheville Annual Council Priorities (Hurricane Helene recovery): Housing
goals.description: Help residents with post-disaster housing; plan for future displacement; support temporary and permanent housing; expand housing options and home repair.
objectives: Connect residents to post-disaster housing resources and funding
Support temporary and permanent housing for displaced residents
Advance home repair programs and increase supply

goals.title: Infrastructure and environment
goals.citation: City of Asheville Annual Council Priorities (Hurricane Helene recovery): Infrastructure and environment
goals.description: Rebuild infrastructure for long-term resilience; improve water system resilience, flood management and stormwater; prepare for climate-related disasters.
objectives: Rebuild infrastructure with a focus on long-term resilience
Improve water system resilience, flood management, and stormwater infrastructure
Strengthen ability to prepare for and respond to climate-related disasters

goals.title: People
goals.citation: City of Asheville Annual Council Priorities (Hurricane Helene recovery): People
goals.description: Support residents recovering from disaster while strengthening community resilience and neighborhood-level preparedness.
objectives: Support residents recovering from disaster impacts
Strengthen neighborhood-level preparedness (resilience hubs, neighborhood disaster planning)
Address pre-existing vulnerabilities amplified by disasters
